caption:
That lead who ghosted you after the quote isn't gone. It's dormant.

Most CRMs let quoted-but-not-booked leads sit untouched. Nobody circles back after 30 days, so leads already paid for disappear.

A win-back sequence fixes that:

Day 14: a short check-in text. No pitch, just a question.
Day 21: a value nudge, a seasonal reminder or a direct answer to the objection that stalled them.
Day 30: a one-line breakup message. This one often earns the most replies.

Example workflow, not a specific client's results.

The Black Arrow platform runs this the moment a lead goes quiet. See it work on your own dormant list with a 14-day free trial.
